title: Coefficient-uniform growing divisibility detects every nonzero bounded sequence

statement.quantifiers: Isolated-at-each-scale finite components X_j with fixed-scale d_j, a product-sequence map D into KX, mu D=0 and finite-support D=0; for each finite r, n(d_j)_r=0 implies M_jr|n eventually, with M_jr tending to infinity independently of n.
statement.assertion: D injects l_infty(N,Z)/Z^(N) into ker(mu); this torsion-free group has continuum rational dimension.
assumptions: A zero colimit class dies at one finite later scale.
Thresholds depend on r but not on coefficients; bounded sequence norm is fixed.
The map on all product classes and analytic vanishing must be proved, not inferred from one constant sequence.

inputs: Exact integral component annihilation divisibility, all-product index vanishing, finite-support disappearance.
outputs: A large integral kernel and continuum rational lower bound.
interface.precision: Non-effective algebraic/class-cardinality statement; no finite witness or uniform computational cost.
costs: Source-specific canonical index and product-class domains imported separately.
Unbounded sequences need not be detected by the boundedness argument.

proof_mechanism: If D(a)=0, restrict the finite later scale to each isolated large component.
M_jr|a_j and eventually M_jr>sup|a_j| force eventual a_j=0.
Encode binary prefixes in N; continuum almost-disjoint infinite sets yield independent indicator classes modulo finite support.
Torsion-freeness and denominator clearing preserve rational independence; cardinality gives the group upper bound.
obstructions: One fixed coefficient surviving does not by itself imply the coefficient-uniform hypothesis.
Kernel size does not transfer to group assembly without a KX-injective index-natural map.

potential_uses.target: Other colimit obstructions with increasing integral torsion/divisibility
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Validate all-coefficient scale thresholds and analytic zero for every product class before amplifying a single obstruction.

review.source_reported: Source claims complete written arguments and scoped finite checks; independent audit receipts or executable replay packages not supplied; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
